fusions.name: Darting Skein
fusions.desc: Looses 4 strands at once, spread apart; each deals 3 damage. You move 10% faster for 2 seconds after using it.

fusions.name: Landed Catch
fusions.desc: Casts a line that deals 14 damage to one enemy within 7 tiles and stuns it for 1 second. Each hit has a 60% chance of [Slowed] for 4 seconds. Deals up to 1.5 times as much at maximum range.

fusions.name: Slipped Knot
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, each condition laid on you has a 50% chance to be sent back to whoever inflicted it instead.

fusions.name: Silver Skein
fusions.desc: Calls a bonded familiar of water that fights beside you, striking for 3 damage every 1.2 seconds. Anything it strikes moves 15% slower for 2 seconds.
